title: fix(gen): add catalog display names and expose the ARD manifest
author: patbing

gist.summary: Added the required `displayName` field, sourced from each MCP server's registry name, to entries in `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json`. Added `GET /.well-known/ard.json` as ARD's canonical entry-source path, returning the same entries in an `{entries}` JSON envelope without the catalog's `specVersion`. Both manifests now use one entry builder, so their listings stay in sync. The existing AI catalog envelope, media type and headers are unchanged; this does not claim full ARD conformance.
